build_cmudict_loader: build a python module that loads a CMUDict file and looks up ARPAbet pronunciations for words
create_cmudict_lookup: create a CMUDict instance from a file path and lookup pronunciations for a given word
test_cmudict_lookup: test the CMUDict class by loading a dictionary file and looking up a word pronunciation
review_cmudict_class: review the CMUDict class and its lookup method for parsing CMU pronunciation dictionary data
refactor_cmudict_ambiguous: refactor the CMUDict class to filter out words with multiple ambiguous pronunciations
